**Yes, the evidence points to native forest loss in 2022, though it is small.**

- Hansen data show 0.6 ha of tree-cover loss in 2022, about 3.4% of the 17.6 ha property. That is above the 0.5 ha minimum event size.
- The JRC 2020 map shows 100% of that area was forest in 2020, so the loss is corroborated. Later years of the series were also observed.
